fieldValues.title: manifest.rootContainerId is required; the root container satisfies core Container invariants 20-21
fieldValues.normative_statement: The root Container MUST satisfy the core Container invariants unchanged: Invariant 20 (its `containerId` is not an instance ID and never appears as an entry `instanceId` in `memberInstanceIds`, nor in `Relation.sourceInstanceId` or `Relation.targetInstanceId`) and Invariant 21 (every entry's `instanceId` in `memberInstanceIds` references a valid SRS instance id). `rootInstanceIds` is removed ([R4]). Amended by RFC-052 (the-greenman/srs#941): `manifest.rootContainerId` is REQUIRED and names a container of the container set; that container is the root container and satisfies these invariants. Amended by RFC-052 Revision 5 (the-greenman/srs#953, owner rulings 2026-10-23): from revision 10 a repository always has exactly one root container. Setting the root changes only `manifest.rootContainerId`, accepts only a container already in the container set, and changes no container: the promoted container and the previous root keep their own titles, `identityInstanceId` and entries, and the previous root stays an ordinary container. Setting it to an id that names no container, or unsetting it, is refused, writing nothing (`manifest-root-container-missing`).
